title: Create daily HKD standing instruction - happy path candidate
expected: Expected to reach CREATE/insert branch if CIF/customer and account master data exist and STORE-REF is unused.

title: Create weekly HKD SI with definite term date
expected: Expected to check holiday/week-day logic, then CREATE if master data is valid.

title: Create monthly/month-end SI
expected: Expected to exercise month-end-run branch. Requires Cycle code M to match generated AgsJ187 enum.

title: Amend existing SI and set suspend period
expected: Expected to reach AMEND/update branch if the AGSTINT record exists and status is P.

title: Delete/cancel existing SI
expected: Expected to reach DELETE branch and set AGSTINT-CODE-STAT to C if record exists and status is P.

title: Invalid: missing both CIFNO and customer number
expected: Expected message seq 230 with reference CIFNO OR CUST AC.

title: Invalid: action not C/A/D
expected: Expected message seq 420 with reference ACTION.

title: Invalid: CRAC-TYPE not I/O
expected: Expected message seq 420 with reference CRAC TYPE.

title: Invalid: one side CNY and other side non-CNY
expected: Expected message seq 231 invalid exchange currency pair.

title: Invalid: both debit amount and credit amount supplied
expected: Expected message seq 230 with reference DR AMT OR CR AMT.

title: Invalid: beneficiary account missing
expected: Expected message seq 404 with reference BENE AC.

title: Invalid: daily/weekly/bi-weekly cycle with month-end flag
expected: Expected message seq 403 with reference MONTH-END.

title: Invalid: indefinite term type but term date supplied
expected: Expected message seq 403 with reference TERM. DATE.
